description: The service-account spec documents no 404 on GetServiceAccountKey or DeleteServiceAccountKey, but the API returns 404 for a key that does not exist: STACKIT's own Terraform provider (stackitcloud/terraform-provider-stackit, stackit/internal/services/serviceaccount/key/resource.go, read 2026-11-01) removes the key from state on http.StatusNotFound in Read and treats http.StatusNotFound as already deleted in Delete. Type it as the model's NotFound so callers can tell a missing key from other failures.
